title: A Level-15 Certificate for the Prime-29 Gate in the Fifteen-Runner Lonely Runner Problem
description: Technical report, exact certificate data, and verification software proving J(14,29) is empty. Every improper level-15 lift of the unique level-one improper orbit is equivalent to a lift in a coprime or noncoprime symmetry branch. Two independently written exact solvers exclude all thirteen coprime coordinate-zero cases. A 210-variable, 1,842-clause CNF and a DRAT proof accepted by DRAT-trim and rate exclude the noncoprime branch. The result closes the prime-29 finite-checking gate for fifteen total runners. It contributes log(29) to the required prime mass and does not prove the full fifteen-runner Lonely Runner Conjecture. Version 0.1.2 is an archival and documentation patch adding an explicit compiled report PDF, a deterministic source bundle, and a checksum manifest. The theorem, proof, certificate, data, and computations are unchanged.
